graham.brief:
Chicago has a new name at the top of the sheet, and the averages behind it belong to somebody else. Case Keenum sat out week 2 and is back for week 3. The books have Keenum at 29.5 pass attempts. Everything else in Chicago follows that.

Chicago's pass defense gives up more through the air than almost anyone, 9th-worst in the league. Chicago is the 9th-most run-first offense in football, running more than the situation calls for. What I can't tell about Philadelphia is whether the number is the team or the name.

Chicago gets clean runs before contact, and Philadelphia keeps playing light in the box. Saquon Barkley is the primary back.

The total has slipped from 44 to 41.5 during the week. The price agrees about the shape here and argues about the size on Philadelphia. Philadelphia is favored by 3.5. I'd rather be flat on Philadelphia than invent a lean. Barkley's carry line opened 18.5 and is 17.5 now. If Chicago runs over the first two series at the season rate, nothing here has changed.
